_comment: One entry per pack model (key = the pack's file name). ref = the real car it was identified as; curb kg; front = share of weight on the front axle; engine = a game engine part row; awd; display = in-game name; length_mm = real length, the model is scaled to it; offroad = Offroad tyres+rims; popup = pop-up headlights; engine_pos = front|mid|rear; dropped = reason the car is not shipped (its id stays reserved).
